 The learned counsel for the petitioners
 submits that the petitioners are arrayed as ac
cused  Nos.1 and 2 in C.C.No.1612 of 2024 on the file of  Additional Junior Civil Judge, Badvel, for alleged  offences under Sections 420 and 509 read with 34  of IPC.

It is submitted that the marriage alliance  between the 1st petitioner and the daughter of the  2nd respondent could not fructify and on the said allegation, a complaint under Section 420 and 509 read with 34 of IPC is filed against the petitioners.
The learned counsel for the petitioners submits that in similar circumstances, this Court with identical facts has considered Crl.P.No.8824 of 2013 and quashed the case.
Considering the same, there shall be stay of all further proceedings in so far as the petitioners are concerned in C.C.No.1612 of 2024 on the file of Additional Junior Civil Judge, Badvel.
The learned counsel for the petitioners is permitted to take out personal notice to the 2nd respondent by RPAD and file proof of service in the Registry.
